payload.title: Render newsroom items with verdict, editor scores, hype gap and evidence
payload.description:
Feature 1. Render real newsroom items with an editor-set verdict, four scores, hype gap and evidence. The mechanism is live. The sample board stays until real items exist.

## Context
- The architecture is in `docs/architecture.md` (PR #16), section 6 "Item pages". The scaffold is in `web/pages/*.md`, `web/assets/shipped-components.css` and `web/projection.json`. The sample item page is `web/pages/sample-tern-3.md` (check its real name) at `/sample/tern-3/`.
- Read the Papyrus guide "Hooks", "Authored page files" (the `block` include) and "Listings": `git -C ~/Projects/Papyrus show origin/main:docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`. Hooks see `summary.front_matter` (a dict) and `page.summaries`. The hooks source is `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/hooks.py` and `entries.py` in Papyrus `origin/main`. A working hooks module is ~/Projects/Anth.us-web-std2/web/hooks.py. Use it for the pattern, not its content.
- Repository rule (AGENTS.md): scoring dimensions and policies are data, never hard-coded in code. Put the dimension list in a small site config `web/scoring.json`, read by the hooks module with `page.site.static_directory` or the module's own path: `{"dimensions":[{"key":"real","label":"Real"},{"key":"useful","label":"Useful"},{"key":"notable","label":"Notable"},{"key":"novel","label":"Novel"}], "hypeGap": {"plus":["notable","novel"],"minus":["real","useful"]}, "verdicts": ["shipped","verified","pending","vapor"]}`. The hooks code is generic: it iterates over the config.

## Front matter contract (editor-set in the CMS)
```yaml
verdict: verified          # one of scoring.json verdicts; missing = pending
verdictBy: the desk        # optional
verdictAt: 2026-10-20      # optional
scores: {real: 4.5, useful: 4, notable: 3.5, novel: 3}   # editor's 1-5 per dimension; any subset
evidence:
  - {kind: weights, url: https://..., check: checked}     # check: checked | partly | unchecked
maker: Some Lab            # optional
entities: [{kind: task, name: code completion}]          # optional, hand-entered until extraction lands
```
Find out how an editor enters front matter in the Papyrus CMS: the item editor's front-matter or YAML field, or a Markus front-matter block in the body. Write it down in a short `docs/editing-items.md` with the example above. Invalid values (score outside 1–5, unknown verdict or check) are left out of the render, and a warning is logged with the item key. They never fail the build.

## Rendering (web/hooks.py, `"hooks": "hooks.py"` in projection.json)
1. `item_decorator(html, summary)`: on an item page, put a header strip above the article. It holds the verdict stamp (`.status-stamp-*` with icon and word), "Checked by {verdictBy}, {verdictAt}" when given, the editor scores as `.score-dimension` with meters (n is not shown, labelled "Editor score"), the hype gap with ▲/▼ and a sign when every hypeGap dimension is present, entity chips, and an evidence list with check marks (✓ Checked, ◐ Partly, ○ Not checked). Reuse the classes the sample item page uses, so it looks like `/sample/tern-3/`.
2. A `block` hook named `desk-board` (`::include{kind="block" name="desk-board" depends="*"}`) renders the real items as board rows (`.board-*` classes), newest first, up to 30, from `page.summaries` of the three sections. Each row has the title linking to the item page, source domain, section, age, verdict stamp, editor scores, and the hype gap. There is no vote column: in its place show "Ratings open with reader sign-in" once in the header. With zero items it renders nothing at all, an empty string.
3. Home (`web/pages/home.md`): put the `desk-board` include above the sample board, under the heading "From the desk" (no sample mark, because it is real). When real items exist, the sample board stays below with its Sample mark. Do not remove it yet. Use the same include on /new/ (newest first). Front, Rising and Vapor log keep their samples.
4. `DEPENDS_ON`: set it so that only home, new and item pages re-render on item saves. See the guide.
5. Use the colourblind rule and the light and dark themes as before.

## Testing (no fabricated content goes live)
- Add a fixture directory `tests/fixtures/content/` with two **obviously fictional** items (titles that start with "Fixture:" and `.example` URLs) that use the full front-matter contract plus one invalid case. Add a Python unittest, `tests/test_hooks.py` (the repo's `npm test` runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`). It projects the fixtures with `papyrus ops content project --all --from-dir tests/fixtures/content --static-dir web --out <tmp>` and asserts the following:
  - the item page has the stamp word and an evidence check word;
  - the home page has two desk-board rows;
  - the invalid score is not rendered.
- The fixtures are never deployed. Projection on deploy reads CMS items only. Check that `--from-dir` is not part of the deploy path.
- Locally, screenshot a fixture item page and the home page at 1440 and 390 in the scratchpad (`<scratchpad>/shots-items/`).

## Ship
- Worktree `<scratchpad>/wt-items`, branch `feat/ship-<id>-real-items` from origin/main. Venv at `<scratchpad>/venv`: run `pip install -r requirements-publication.txt` first, because the Papyrus pin is now 5.15.1.
- PR into main titled `feat: render newsroom items with verdict, editor scores, hype gap and evidence (ship-<id>)`. Commit trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. The PR body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". Wait for CI, then `gh pr merge --merge`, watch the deploy run, and confirm live that `/`, `/new/`, `/sample/tern-3/` and a section page return 200 and that the sample board is still marked. AWS reads only: `AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production`, after asserting account 712236451410. No writes, and never create or publish CMS items.

## Report
The PR URL, merge commit, deploy run, live check, how an editor sets the front matter (one paragraph), screenshot paths, and anything simplified.
